blocks.content: The purpose of this Information Security Policy is to establish the organization’s commitment to protect its information assets, define the principles and requirements for information security management, and provide a framework for achieving the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

This Information Security Policy applies to all information assets, processes, systems, and activities under the control of the organization, and to all personnel, contractors, and third‑party users who access, process, store, or transmit information on behalf of the organization.
The organization adheres to the core principles of information security (CIA Triad): Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability.
Management Commitment
Top management commits to establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving the Information Security Management System in accordance with ISO/IEC 27001.

items: Provide the necessary resources, including personnel, budget and technology, to achieve information security objectives.
Ensure that the information security policy is communicated, understood and applied throughout the organization.
Review the performance of the ISMS at planned intervals and take corrective actions as needed.
Support the identification, assessment and treatment of information security risks.
Promote a culture of information security awareness and responsibility among all employees.

blocks.content: The organization shall establish and maintain information security objectives that support the protection of its assets, compliance obligations, and the continual improvement of the ISMS.

items: Ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information assets in accordance with business requirements.
Comply with applicable legal, regulatory and contractual security obligations.
Identify, assess and treat information security risks to achieve an acceptable risk level.
Promote a culture of security awareness and competence among personnel.

blocks.content: Information Security Risk Management

The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain a risk management framework that identifies, evaluates, and addresses information security risks in accordance with its risk appetite and applicable requirements.

items: Identify information assets and associated threats and vulnerabilities
Assess the likelihood and impact of identified risks
Determine risk treatment options and prioritize actions
Document risk assessment outcomes and treatment decisions
Communicate risk information to relevant stakeholders
Define the scope and criteria for risk assessment
Conduct risk identification and analysis
Perform risk evaluation against defined criteria
Select and implement risk treatment measures
Monitor risk treatment effectiveness and update risk assessments as needed

blocks.content: Roles and Responsibilities
The organization defines and assigns information security responsibilities to ensure effective implementation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
This Information Security Policy is supported by the following policies and procedures:
No additional framework documents are currently defined.
Security Awareness and Competence

The organization shall maintain an information security awareness and competence program that ensures all personnel understand their security responsibilities and possess the necessary skills to protect information assets.

items: All employees shall receive initial security awareness training upon commencement of employment.
Ongoing training shall be provided to reinforce awareness of emerging threats and policy updates.
Role‑specific security competencies shall be defined and verified for personnel with access to critical or sensitive information.
The effectiveness of the awareness program shall be evaluated regularly and improvements implemented as necessary.

blocks.content: Responsibility for the program resides with the designated information security function, which shall develop, deliver, and monitor training activities.
Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements

The organization shall ensure that all applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security are identified, documented, and incorporated into the Information Security Management System (ISMS) in a continual manner.

items: Identify and maintain a register of all applicable legal and regulatory obligations affecting information security; review the register at planned intervals and upon any change to the legal landscape.
Incorporate contractual security obligations from third‑party agreements into the ISMS processes; ensure that such obligations are monitored for compliance and addressed in risk treatment decisions.

blocks.content: Monitoring and Performance Evaluation
The organization shall continuously monitor the Information Security Management System (ISMS) to ensure its effectiveness and conformity with the established security objectives.
Performance shall be evaluated through systematic analysis of monitoring results, identification of improvement opportunities, and implementation of corrective actions.

items: Internal audits of the ISMS
Management reviews of security performance
Assessment of compliance with legal and regulatory requirements
Analysis of security incidents and trends

blocks.content: All personnel are required to comply with the provisions of this Information Security Policy and any associated procedural documentation.

items: Any request for a deviation from a policy requirement shall be submitted in writing to the designated authority for assessment.
Approved exceptions shall be recorded, confined to a defined scope and period, and subject to periodic review to confirm continued applicability.

blocks.content: The organization shall establish and maintain effective communication mechanisms to support the availability of information security information to relevant parties.
All critical security communications, including alerts, incidents, and policy updates, shall be disseminated through approved channels in a timely manner to ensure continuity of operations.
Communication procedures shall define the responsibilities for creating, approving, distributing, and acknowledging security messages, and shall be reviewed periodically for effectiveness.

Availability of security communication services shall be maintained in accordance with the organization’s business continuity requirements, ensuring that essential information is accessible during normal and disrupted conditions.

This Information Security Policy shall be reviewed at least to be defined or following any significant changes to the organization's environment, legal obligations, or technical infrastructure to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
